text: July 2026: we cleaned 24 solar panels on an Ashmore home. They were covered in white bird droppings, dust spots and lichen along the frames. After a hose and brush clean, the panels were clear and shiny, standing out against the stained roof tiles beside them.
alt: Before and after of the panel corner at roof edge. Before: Panel covered in white bird droppings and dust spots, with tile ridge beyond. Aft in Ashmore
